description: Deposit stablecoin into the Solinkify pre-paid balance so future gate_fetch calls debit it without a per-request transaction. Moves money: the full deposit counts against the daily spending cap at once, and the balance can be withdrawn later.

amount_usd.description: Amount to deposit, in whole currency units (1.5 means $1.50, not 1500000 base units). Must be positive and within the remaining daily cap.

token.description: Stablecoin to deposit. Must match the token the target endpoints price in, since balances do not convert between tokens. Defaults to USDC.

name: gate_prepaid_deposit
